question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5. **
solution:
The correct answer is: "**into**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The preposition "**into**" is used to indicate movement or direction towards the inside of something.
 
• In this context, the blank refers to a physical space where something is being filled in, so "**into**" is the most appropriate option.
